article.title: A/B Testing: Statistical Significance versus Practical Impact

paragraphs.en: An A/B test compares two experiences by randomly assigning eligible users to different groups. Imagine a company testing a redesigned signup page. The original page is shown to the control group, while the treatment group sees the new version. After two weeks, the treatment group appears to convert more visitors into registered users. This sounds encouraging, but the team should not immediately declare success. It must first verify that randomization worked, the tracking system counted events consistently, and the measurement window was defined before the experiment began. A broken experiment can produce precise-looking numbers without reliable evidence.
paragraphs.zh: A/B 測試透過隨機分派合格用戶，比較兩種體驗。假設公司測試新版註冊頁，控制組看舊版，實驗組看新版。兩週後實驗組轉換較高，看似令人鼓舞，但必須先確認隨機分派有效、追蹤一致、觀察期間事先訂好。設計有問題的實驗仍可能產生看似精確但不可靠的數字。
paragraphs.ja: A/Bテストは対象者を無作為に二群へ割り付け、体験の違いを比較します。新しい登録画面の成績が良くても、無作為化、計測の一貫性、事前に決めた観測期間を確認しなければなりません。設計に欠陥があれば精密に見える数字も信頼できません。

paragraphs.en: Statistical significance concerns uncertainty, not business value. A p-value indicates how unusual the observed result, or a more extreme one, would be under a specified null hypothesis. It does not tell us the probability that the hypothesis is true, and it does not directly measure the probability that a product change will succeed. A statistically significant difference can be tiny when the sample is huge. On the other hand, a promising effect may not be statistically significant when the sample is too small. Interpreting either outcome requires attention to uncertainty and the practical size of the change.
paragraphs.zh: 統計顯著性處理不確定性，不直接代表商業價值。p 值是在特定虛無假設下，得到目前或更極端結果的罕見程度，不是該假設為真的機率，也不是產品變更成功的機率。樣本很大時極小差異也可能顯著；樣本太小時有希望的效果也可能不顯著。
paragraphs.ja: 統計的有意差は不確実性の問題で、事業価値そのものではありません。p値は帰無仮説の下で観測値以上の極端な結果が得られる程度を示します。仮説が正しい確率ではありません。大標本では微小な差も有意になり、小標本では有望な効果が有意にならない場合があります。

paragraphs.en: Suppose the control group has a conversion rate of four percent and the treatment group reaches 4.2 percent. The absolute difference is 0.2 percentage points; the relative lift is five percent. Both figures are correct, but they communicate different things. If one million comparable visitors arrive each month, the estimated difference represents about two thousand additional conversions, provided the effect persists. Whether that improvement is worth implementing depends on the profit per conversion, engineering costs, and possible effects on customer satisfaction. Reporting only relative lift can make a small absolute change sound more dramatic than it is.
paragraphs.zh: 若控制組轉換率4%、實驗組4.2%，絕對差異是0.2個百分點，相對提升5%。兩者都正確，但意義不同。若每月有100萬名相似訪客且效果持續，估計可多2000次轉換。是否值得實施仍取決於單次轉換利潤、工程成本與客戶滿意度。只報相對提升可能誇大印象。
paragraphs.ja: 対照群4%、施策群4.2%なら絶対差は0.2ポイント、相対改善は5%です。月間百万人の同等の訪問者なら約二千件の追加登録に相当しますが、利益や開発費、満足度への影響も必要です。相対改善だけでは印象を誇張しかねません。

paragraphs.en: A confidence interval communicates the range of effects compatible with the data under a particular method. An interval that includes both a modest loss and a meaningful gain should make decision makers cautious. Before the experiment, teams should choose a primary metric, a minimum effect worth detecting, a significance threshold, and a sample-size target. Statistical power depends on the baseline rate and expected effect, among other assumptions. These choices help prevent researchers from changing the success criteria after seeing the results. They also make it easier to explain why a test was inconclusive rather than simply labeling it a failure.
paragraphs.zh: 信賴區間呈現依特定方法與資料相容的效果範圍。若同時包含小幅損失與可觀收益，決策者應謹慎。實驗前應選定主要指標、值得偵測的最小效果、顯著門檻及樣本數。檢定力取決於基準率與預期效果等假設。預先決定可避免事後更改成功標準，也有助於解釋不確定結果。
paragraphs.ja: 信頼区間は手法とデータに整合する効果の範囲です。損失と有益な改善の双方を含む場合は慎重な判断が必要です。実験前に主要指標、最小検出効果、有意水準、標本数を定めます。検出力は基準率や想定効果に依存し、事前設定は結果を見て基準を変える行為を防ぎます。

paragraphs.en: Repeatedly checking the p-value and stopping as soon as it falls below a threshold can increase false positives unless the analysis accounts for sequential monitoring. Looking at many customer segments or dozens of metrics introduces another source of misleading discoveries. Appropriate adjustments and a documented analysis plan reduce these risks. Teams also need guardrail metrics. A signup page might increase registrations while generating more refunds, complaints, or support requests. A product change should be evaluated as a whole rather than celebrated because one visible metric improved. The measurement design must match the actual decision the organization faces.
paragraphs.zh: 若反覆檢查 p 值，一達門檻就停止，卻未採用適當序列檢定，可能提高偽陽性。查看許多客群或指標也會造成誤導。校正方法與書面分析計畫能降低風險。還要看護欄指標：註冊數增加的同時，退款、客訴或客服需求也可能上升。應評估整體產品變更，而不是只慶祝一個數字改善。
paragraphs.ja: p値を繰り返し見て閾値を下回った時点で停止すると、逐次解析を考慮しない場合に偽陽性が増えます。多数のセグメントや指標も同様です。補正と分析計画に加え、返金、苦情、問い合わせなどのガードレール指標を確認します。

paragraphs.en: A strong experiment report separates observed evidence from the recommended action. It states the target population, assignment method, sample size, primary metric, absolute difference, relative lift, uncertainty interval, and guardrail outcomes. It also explains what assumptions would be required to extend the result to other users or future months. The appropriate response might be to launch the new design, gather more data, or reject the change. None of these choices follows automatically from a single p-value. Statistical tools support judgment; they do not replace it. A transparent report lets colleagues challenge the assumptions and improve the next experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 好的實驗報告應分開呈現觀察證據與建議行動，寫明目標母體、分派方式、樣本數、主要指標、絕對差異、相對提升、不確定區間與護欄結果，並解釋外推到其他用戶或月份的假設。可能決定上線、蒐集更多資料或否決方案。單一 p 值無法自動決定；透明報告才能讓同事檢視假設、改善下一次實驗。
paragraphs.ja: 良い報告書は観測された証拠と推奨行動を分け、対象者、割付方法、標本数、主要指標、絶対差、相対改善、区間推定、ガードレール結果を示します。他の利用者や将来へ一般化する前提も明記します。公開、追加調査、中止はp値だけでは決まりません。
